section.catchline: Nonrefundable tax credit for a donation to the Carson Smith Opportunity Scholarship Program.
section.subsection: Except as provided in Subsection (3), a claimant, estate, or trust that makes a donation to the Carson Smith Opportunity Scholarship Program established in Section 53E-7-402 may claim a nonrefundable tax credit equal to 100% of the amount stated on a tax credit certificate issued in accordance with Section 53E-7-407.
The tax credit described in Subsection (1) may be claimed for the taxable year indicated on the tax credit certificate issued in accordance with Section 53E-7-407.

A claimant, estate, or trust may not claim the tax credit described in Subsection (1) for a donation to the extent the claimant, estate, or trust claims the donation as a deduction or credit against the claimant's, estate's, or trust's federal income taxes for any taxable year.
